items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: so I looked at Hawk and Gerry Mulligan and they said nice, Cozy.

ctx.x: It sounded like nothing to me, so I looked at Hawk and Gerry Mulligan and they said nice, Cozy. Well you know they don't want to bring me down and say, Cozy, that sound terrible, you know, but it sound just terrible to me, because I had another side that I was going to pick up, the A side or the B side, I just forget now. So, in a way I'm glad they did edit it like that it satisfied all these other tin ears out here that didn't know anything about music, and so before I knew it it was about 75 on the charts, the…
Did you ever get any royalties from it?
